forecasts.question: Will Iran's IRGC confirm conducting a ballistic or cruise missile attack against US military assets or personnel before EOD September 16, 2026?
forecasts.delta_reason: KEEP. No confirmed IRGC ballistic or cruise missile attack against US forces observed September 13. Day 198 OPREP noted the IRGC maritime restricted-area announcement (Sep 9) produced no attack against Gulf commercial or US shipping; Lebanon front was quiet for a second consecutive day. A vessel was struck near Hengam Island around 0500 local Sep 13, killing one Iranian mariner (UKMTO), but the attacker was unconfirmed and the target was an Iranian commercial vessel, not a US military asset. The near-daily attack cadence of September 1–11 is the primary base-rate driver for 0.55; a one-day quiet is insufficient to reduce. Horizon is EOD Sep 16 with 2 days remaining. Sunday cold-start: p_cold=0.55; gap 0pp — confirmed within tolerance.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if CENTCOM or DoD officially confirms an IRGC ballistic missile, cruise missile, or drone attack against a US military asset, installation, or personnel between 2026-09-13 and EOD 2026-09-16. An attack that is attempted but fully intercepted still counts as YES (attack confirmed; interception does not negate the attempt).
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: CENTCOM official statement OR DoD press briefing OR Reuters/AP/AFP reporting a confirmed US military statement naming IRGC as the attacker.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: A Houthi or Hezbollah attack against a US asset, even if IRGC-coordinated, does NOT count unless DoD explicitly attributes to IRGC command. An unconfirmed Iranian government claim of a successful attack, without US military confirmation, = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

forecasts.question: Will a confirmed Iran-US indirect negotiating session (mediated, senior officials, named principals) occur before EOD 2026-09-17?
forecasts.delta_reason: UPDATE 0.12→0.10. Oman's September 13 postponement of the Salalah GCC-Iran ministerial meeting removed the nearest multilateral diplomatic framework that might have created conditions for a US-Iran track. The Salalah meeting had no US mandate, but its failure tightens the diplomatic environment: Bahrain's boycott and Gulf hesitation leave Oman as the primary mediating channel with reduced coalition support. Trump's Sep 9 midterm framing ('war ends immediately after midterms') remains the dominant US position; IAEA referral Sep 9 hardened Iranian positions. No mediator readout of a convened session has appeared; FM Araghchi's Sep 10 call with Pakistan Army Chief Gen. Munir was message relay, not a session. Horizon is EOD Sep 17 with 3 days remaining. Sunday cold-start: p_cold=0.08; inherited 0.12; gap 4pp — within tolerance. Judge: select 0.10 (splitting Analyst 0.09 and DA 0.12).
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a TIER1 source reports a face-to-face or formally convened indirect negotiating session (not mere message relay) between named US and Iranian senior officials/envoys, hosted by a named mediator (Oman/Pakistan/Qatar/Switzerland/Saudi Arabia), between 2026-09-03 and 2026-09-17.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 OR one TIER1 + official mediator readout.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Message relay through intermediaries without a convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. Trump assertions of 'semi-negotiating' without Iranian or mediator confirmation of a held session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if Oman, Pakistan, Qatar, or Saudi Arabia's Foreign Minister or MFA issues a public statement confirming an upcoming or ongoing Iran-US indirect session involving named senior officials, before EOD 2026-09-27. Message relay or 'proximity talks' without a confirmed date do NOT count.
